info.title: Granola API
info.description: API for accessing meeting data from Granola

get.description: Lists the notes the API key can read, newest first by creation time. Only notes with a generated summary are returned.

schema.description: Return notes created before this date
Return notes created after this date
Return notes updated after this date
Return notes in this folder and any of its child folders. Folder IDs are case-insensitive. Use the list folders endpoint to discover folder IDs.
The cursor to continue from
Maximum number of notes to return per page
Return notes in this space. Space IDs are case-insensitive. Use the list spaces endpoint to discover space IDs.

get.description: Returns one note with its summary, attendees, calendar event and folders. Pass `include=transcript` to add the transcript. A note the key cannot read, or one without a generated summary, returns `NOTE_NOT_FOUND`.

schema.description: The ID of the note (case-insensitive)

413.description: Transcript is too large to return inline. Retrieve it in pages from `/v1/notes/{note_id}/transcript`.

get.description: Retrieve a meeting transcript in pages, including when Get Note returns `TRANSCRIPT_TOO_LARGE`.

schema.description: The ID of the note (case-insensitive)
The opaque cursor returned by the previous page

403.description: Forbidden - A workspace admin has turned off transcript access over the API

get.description: Lists the folders the API key can read, ordered by name.

schema.description: The cursor to continue from
Maximum number of folders to return per page

get.description: Lists the spaces the API key can access, ordered by name.

schema.description: The cursor to continue from
The number of spaces to return

404.description: Spaces are not enabled for this workspace

get.description: Lists your workspace's audit events, newest first. Requires an Audit API key.

schema.description: Return only events with this exact action, or events whose action starts with it followed by a dot (`workspace` returns `workspace.member_added` but not `workspace_automation.created`). Lowercase, as actions are.
Return events that occurred before this date. Must fall within the one-year retention window; an earlier date is rejected.
Return events that occurred after this date. Must fall within the one-year retention window; an earlier date is rejected.

post.description: Registers an HTTPS URL to receive event deliveries. With a Workspace API key the endpoint is workspace-managed: pass `scopes: ["workspace"]` (the key's own scope), and `folder_ids` may only reference folders the key can list.

201.description: Webhook endpoint created. The signing secret is only returned here.

403.description: Forbidden - A requested scope is disabled by the workspace's API access controls

404.description: Not found - The webhooks API is not available for this workspace

200.description: Webhook endpoint created. The signing secret is only returned here.

get.description: Lists the webhook endpoints the API key can manage, oldest first.

404.description: Not found - The webhooks API is not available for this workspace

patch.description: Changes an endpoint's URL, scopes, events, folder filter or enabled state. Fields you leave out stay as they are.

schema.description: The ID of the webhook endpoint. Case-insensitive.

403.description: Forbidden - A requested scope is disabled by the workspace's API access controls, the caller is not the endpoint's creator (non-creators can only change enabled), or the endpoint is workspace-managed (its scope is fixed)

delete.description: Deletes a webhook endpoint. Granola stops sending it events.

schema.description: The ID of the webhook endpoint. Case-insensitive.

post.description: Places a named legal hold on custodians in your workspace. Granola preserves a custodian's notes, transcripts and attachments while any hold covering them is active. Custodians see no change in the product.

201.description: The legal hold that was created

400.description: Bad request, or a custodian is not a member of this workspace

409.description: A live legal hold with this name already exists in your workspace

200.description: The legal hold that was created

get.description: Lists every legal hold in your workspace, newest first. Released holds are returned alongside active ones, each carrying `released_at`.

schema.description: The cursor to continue from
Maximum number of legal holds to return per page

get.description: Returns one legal hold. A released hold is still returned, carrying `released_at`.

schema.description: The legal hold id. Case-insensitive.

patch.description: Renames or re-describes a hold, or widens and narrows its workspace-wide coverage. Toggling coverage never touches the custodians the hold names. A released hold cannot be updated.

schema.description: The legal hold id. Case-insensitive.

409.description: A live legal hold with this name already exists in your workspace

delete.description: Releases a hold. Release is terminal: the hold is never deleted, there is no un-release, and a matter that reopens is a new hold. Releasing an already-released hold returns its original `released_at`.

schema.description: The legal hold id. Case-insensitive.

post.description: Names users on a hold, by email or by Granola user id. Idempotent: the response carries the request's full resolved set, whether each entry was newly added or already present.

schema.description: The legal hold id. Case-insensitive.

200.description: The custodians named in the request

400.description: Bad request, or a custodian is not a member of this workspace

get.description: Lists the users a hold names, oldest first. Removed custodians are returned alongside active ones, each carrying `removed_at`.

schema.description: The legal hold id. Case-insensitive.

delete.description: Removes a custodian from a hold. The record of who was held survives: the entry is returned by the list endpoint with `removed_at` set. A custodian id that was never issued returns 404.

post.description:
Search notes by keyword in their titles and summaries, or filter them by participant, folder, space or date. Private notes and transcripts are not searched.

Recent notes can be missing until their summary is generated; use List notes for a complete listing. Keys with the Notes by ID scope get no results.

keywords.summary: Find notes with a calendar participant from Acme

nextPage.summary: Continue with the cursor from the previous response

browse.summary: List notes newest first, with no filters

200.description: Matching notes and whether there are more pages

400.description: Invalid request body, or an expired cursor

404.description: Folder or space not found, or the API key's access scope cannot use this endpoint

post.description:
Search meeting transcripts by keyword to find where something was said. Each result is a note with up to two short excerpts from its transcript; use Get transcript to read the conversation around them.

Recent meetings can be missing until their note's summary is generated. Keys with the Notes by ID scope get no results.

space_id.description: The ID of the space the folder belongs to, or null if it is not in a space or the API key cannot access that space.

diarization_label.description: The diarized anonymous speaker label assigned in the transcript, such as `Speaker A`. This is currently only present on iOS transcripts when diarization is available.

name.description: The resolved name of the identified speaker, such as `Alice Smith`. This is only present when a speaker could be identified for the transcript item.

type.description: The attachment type: `photo` for manually attached images. Clients should ignore types they do not recognize.

updated_at.description: The last update time of the note

private_notes_text.description: The private notes the note's owner wrote themselves, as plain text. Only returned when the API key belongs to the user who created the note; `null` otherwise (including for shared notes and workspace-scoped keys).

private_notes_markdown.description: The private notes the note's owner wrote themselves, in markdown format. Only returned when the API key belongs to the user who created the note; `null` otherwise (including for shared notes and workspace-scoped keys).

transcript.description: The inline transcript of the note. It is null unless you pass `include=transcript`, or when a workspace admin has turned off transcript access over the API. If it is too large to return inline, Get Note returns `TRANSCRIPT_TOO_LARGE`; retrieve it in pages from `/v1/notes/{note_id}/transcript`. The example below shows a macOS transcript. On iOS, Granola currently returns `speaker.source` as `microphone`, and `diarization_label` can carry anonymous `Speaker A/B/...` buckets when diarization is available.

SearchNotesRequestFromDate.description: Only meetings that started at or after this date or UTC timestamp. A date means midnight UTC. Notes without a calendar event use their creation time.

SearchNotesRequestToDate.description: Only meetings that started at or before this date or UTC timestamp. A date means midnight UTC at the start of that day, so it leaves out meetings later that day.

SearchNotesRequestUpdatedAfter.description: Only notes whose content or summary changed after this date or UTC timestamp. A date means midnight UTC.

id.description: The ID of the audit event

action.description: The action that was recorded. See the [audit events reference](/audit-events) for every action and the `data` it carries. Actions are added over time, so treat this as an open set of strings rather than a fixed list.

occurred_at.description: When the action happened, to the millisecond

collected_at.description: When Granola recorded the event. Usually the same moment as `occurred_at`, but later for events we learn about after the fact: a meeting recording is recorded once its summary finishes, and a note viewed offline is recorded when that device next reaches us. Events are returned in `collected_at` order, so this is the field that never moves under a cursor, and it carries microseconds to keep events that share a millisecond ordered.

created_at.description: The creation time of the note

updated_at.description: The last update time of the note

deleted_at.description: When the note was deleted, or null if it has not been. Only keys with access to all workspace notes can see deleted notes.

meeting_at.description: When the meeting started according to the calendar, or the note's creation time if it has no calendar event.

ListAuditEvents200ResponseEventsItemData.description: Details of the action. The fields depend on the action, and their names are the ones Granola records internally, so they are camelCase rather than snake_case. See the [audit events reference](/audit-events) for the fields each action carries.

ip_address.description: The IP address the request came from, or null if it was not recorded.

user_agent.description: The user agent of the client that made the request, or null if it was not recorded.

client_version.description: The Granola client version that made the request, or null if it was not recorded.

ListAuditEvents200ResponseEventsItemCont.description: How the request that produced this event reached Granola

text.description: An excerpt of up to 240 characters around a matching word. It can start or end mid-sentence and does not name the speaker.
text.example: so the pricing for the Greek range goes up in January, and we tell the retailers next week

start_time.description: Approximately when the excerpt was spoken, or null when unknown. Use it to find the excerpt in Get transcript.

matched_keywords.description: Every keywords entry found in the section of the transcript the excerpt is cut from. The excerpt shows only part of that section, so it may not contain them all.

SpeakerSource.description: The source of the speaker. For iOS transcripts, Granola currently returns `microphone` for all transcript items because iOS currently captures a single audio stream. Clients should not assume this will never expand in the future.

SpeakerAttribution.description: Who said this relative to the note: `me` is the note-taker (the note's owner), `them` is other meeting participants. Omitted when the attribution is unknown, such as iOS transcript items that only carry an anonymous `diarization_label`.

NoteObject.description: The object type of the note

TranscriptInclude.description: Include the note transcript in the response. If a workspace admin has turned off transcript access over the API, `transcript` is null. If it is too large to return inline, Get Note returns `TRANSCRIPT_TOO_LARGE`; retrieve it in pages from `/v1/notes/{note_id}/transcript`.

SearchNotes200ResponseCompletionStatus.description: more_available: fetch the next page with cursor. exhausted: there are no more matches. incomplete: the search stopped after examining 10,000 notes without finishing; narrow it and search again.

SearchTranscripts200ResponseCompletionSt.description: more_available: fetch the next page with cursor. exhausted: there are no more matches. incomplete: the search stopped after examining 10,000 notes without finishing; narrow it and search again.
